MUST: record the archived XML in the delivery ledger's `--pit` input.

PIT output lives under `core/target/pit-reports/`.

summary: The revised docs establish the intended worktree and PIT routing, but one checkout command changes shell state and the newly mandated core-PIT path is not recognized by the unattended delivery gate.

findings.title: Skill check leaves the shell in the owned worktree
findings.trigger: The shared checkout contains the current agent's uncommitted paths when checkout isolation is needed, and the agent runs the displayed two-line block in one shell before following the next instruction to create a patch and restore paths in the shared checkout.
findings.consequence: The subsequent git diff, patch, or cleanup command runs in the new clean worktree rather than the shared checkout, so the agent can omit its changes from delivery or modify the wrong checkout.
findings.evidence: workflow.md:12-19 adds a persistent cd immediately before instructions that require operating on the shared checkout. The matching commands in AGENTS.md:64 and .agents/skills/project-delivery/references/commands.md:28 use a subshell, preserving the shared checkout as the caller's working directory.
findings.suggestedFix: Use `(cd .worktrees/<topic> && python3 scripts/check-worktree-skills.py)` in this block, then explicitly enter the owned worktree only after the patch transfer and shared-checkout restoration are complete.

findings.title: Issue runner skips required PIT for core source changes
findings.trigger: An unattended issue changes a real library file under core/src/main/java and follows the new default core PIT route.
findings.consequence: pit_gate classifies the change as having no main sources and returns skipped, allowing the issue-runner path to proceed without the mutation-verification gate that the new delivery contract requires.
findings.evidence: gates.py:18 matches only src/main/java paths, while all library sources are under core/src/main/java; gates.py:143-146 therefore returns `skip`. Even after recognizing the source, gates.py:23 and 147-149 look for target/pit-reports/mutations.xml, whereas the documented runner in commands.md:25 and commands.md:51-54 writes core/target/pit-reports/mutations.xml and archives it.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the issue-runner path classifiers and PIT report lookup core-aware, requiring the runner's core report or an explicit archived report, and add a gate test using a core/src/main/java change.
